verdict.rationale: First-party privacy docs refer to a 'Model Improvement' privacy setting that users can enable. They also describe the case 'when you allow us to use your chats' for training, and note that incognito chats are never used to improve Claude, which gives a per-chat opt-out. Separately, Gmail, Drive and Calendar connector data is never used for training. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of where the Model Improvement toggle lives and its default state, details on whether opting out applies retroactively, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the controls work as described.
